node_name.title: Node Name
node_name.description: Name of the new node. Whitespace-only names are rejected.

node_type.title: Node Type
node_type.description: Node type to create when no template is used.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional free-text description of the node.

template_id.title: Template Id
template_id.description: ID of the template to base this node on. If omitted, an empty node of `node_type` is created. Use `project:<node_type>/<slug>` for project-scoped templates, or a plain template ID for global templates.
